name: Iori
message: 「……Where is it？ It should definitely be around here.」
No matter how much I look around, there’s no sign of it.

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t tell me... has someone else already...？」
It was early morning, on my way from the dorms to the classroom.
I saw a notification, so I opened it, and it turned out the radar I’d set up yesterday had picked up a signal.
So, I rushed over to where the signal was, but...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, what are you doing here, Sensei？ Looking for someone？」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, Setsugekka. Early as ever... w-woah！？」
Behind Setsugekka, who was waving hello. No doubt about it, it's right behind her！！

name: Iori
message: 「There！ Found it, I found it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eek！？ What, what, where, where！？ What popped out！？」
Setsugekka turns around in a panic.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Geez, don't scare me like that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You made me think Kei-chan was coming to yell at me again or something！」

name: Iori
message: 「Something that would get me scolded again... oh, wait a second！」

name: Iori
message: 「HR main panel, on！ Preparing for capture！ Timing it right... now！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes！ I did it, Pochemon captured！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Po-poche... what？ Sensei, are you feeling alright？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m fine. Thanks to that, I managed to capture it safely.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you mean, 'capture'？」
Setsugekka walks over closer.

name: Iori
message: 「Here, look at this. Switching to HR mode: public.」
I displayed a cute, stylized 3D model of a monster in front of Setsugekka.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What is this, it’s so cute! Is this an animal？」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s right. It’s an HR animal monster raising game, known as 'Pochemon GO'！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, how adorable... this is a cat, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, a cat-type monster, to be precise. Nyankle, huh... yeah, yeah, good boy.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nyankle, huh... Sensei, I want one too!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that won't do. I can't give this one up」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehhhhh！？ Teacher, you're such a stingy-pants！」

name: Iori
message: 「This is a game where you have to catch and train them yourself, so—wait, you don't know that, do you, Setsugekka?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Train？ That sounds even more interesting! What do you mean by train？」

name: Iori
message: 「Interested？ Heh heh heh... If you train them, they become much stronger than they are now, which gives you an advantage in battles.」
I explain the basics of training and Pochemon GO.

name: Iori
message: 「...Something like that. It’s suddenly become really popular lately. It’s actually pretty hard to catch them out in the city.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want to try it！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher, I want to try catching them too！」

name: Iori
message: 「You want to try catching Pochemon？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! Teacher, please let me try it too!」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then let's try it together.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay~♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okay, Setsugekka Expedition Team, setting off on a journey to catch some Pochemon~♪」
I take off the list that serves as the base unit and teach her how to operate it. Time to turn on the long-range radar immediately！

name: Iori
message: 「I never thought Setsugekka would be interested in this.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, so this is how you search for them~」
Setsugekka leans in against my body.
Her hair, so close by, has a fluffy, really lovely scent.

name: Iori
message: 「...Se-Setsugekka, could you move a little bit away?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh~ but then I can't see it.」
The HR is displayed toward me, so I understand that it's hard to see unless she brings her face close to mine.
It's just that, being this close to a female student is...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, hey, hey, Teacher, what is this？」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, that's...」
At the tip of Setsugekka's finger, there was a small signal in the corner of the radar.

name: Iori
message: 「This signal means there's a Pochemon right here.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then that cute little one from earlier is right here？！」

name: Iori
message: 「It might be a different Pochemon from Nyankuru, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then let's go over there!」
Setsugekka takes my hand and starts tugging me along eagerly.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, Sensei! Hurry, hurry~!」

name: Iori
message: 「There's no need to rush like that. There aren't many people around at this hour.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? Sensei, your palm feels kind of... hard.」
She squeezes my hand over and over.

name: Iori
message: 「I've done nothing but train ever since I was a kid, after all.」
From calluses forming and tearing open over and over again, my hand has ended up with several rough, gnarly bumps.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Is that so... I wonder if mine will end up like this someday, too.」
Setsugekka keeps gently stroking my palm. It tickles a little.

name: Iori
message: 「If you keep up with Jindou, I think it's unavoidable to some extent. Though your hands are really soft, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Uh... ahaha, thank you very much.」
Looking embarrassed, Setsugekka timidly pulls her hand back. Her face is faintly flushed.

name: Iori
message: 「S-Sorry, that was a weird thing to say！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, not at all! I am most humbly honored by your praise.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Well, I'm a maiden right now, too, after all. Ehehe...」
She fidgets, twisting her fingers together.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, you prefer soft hands after all, don't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I like soft hands, too, but I also like rough, hardened hands shaped by tireless effort. I think they're both attractive.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I see... Then that means it's okay even if I keep doing Jindou!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait—what am I even saying？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahahaha! Pretend you didn't hear that!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, Sensei, let's go catch a Pochemon！」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-Yeah, you're right！」
Trying to distract ourselves from the various distractions, we headed toward the destination indicated by the radar.

name: Iori
message: 「Man... we’ve come an awfully long way in. Setsugekka, what’s the reading...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, it should be close. Huh？ That’s strange...」
Before we knew it, we’d made it all the way to the workshop. Perhaps the signal is weak, but Setsugekka seems to be having trouble pinpointing it.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, there are all sorts of machine tools in the workshop. Be careful while you look.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, understood. I tend to get so carried away once I start looking for them~」
As we were saying that, the radar picked up a signal.

name: Iori
message: 「There! Behind the large cutting machine!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Maybe the shadow is why the reading was acting up？ Alright, time to get ready to capture it~♪」
Hmm？ That’s an odd waveform. And that rank type that flashed for just a split second...？

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mr. Muragaki, I can throw it now, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait！ This might just be an incredibly valuable Pochemon...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh? What do you mean by that?」

name: Iori
message: 「There’s no mistake. This signal... it’s a Mega Rare！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mega... rare? What’s that? Is it some kind of rare Pochemon?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah... ‘rare’ doesn’t even begin to cover it. It’s an ultra-rare guy that only appears with a one-in-ten-thousand chance.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「O-one in ten thousand...！？ Wh-what should we do！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Stay calm. It should still be in the shadow of the machine, so I don’t think it’s noticed us yet.」

name: Iori
message: 「Unlike other Pochemon, once a Mega Rare gets away from you, it moves to a completely different location.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How far does it run? To the school gate or something?」

name: Iori
message: 「At the very least, somewhere further than the mainland... I’d imagine？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eeeehhh!!!？ There’s no way we could find it then. *Gulp*... I absolutely cannot let it get away.」
There wasn’t much time left before class started, and this was our first and last chance. A wave of tension hit us all at once.

name: Iori
message: 「Even I’ve never encountered one before. This is nerve-wracking...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-this is a job for the battle-hardened catcher, Mr. Muragaki...！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it’s a Mega Rare drawn in by your luck, Setsugekka. I really want to leave this to you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-wait, are you sure I should be the one to catch it！？ Okay, I’ve got this... just leave it to me！」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s a big moment, Setsugekka. You’ve only got one shot, so give it everything you’ve got！ I’m counting on you...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuuugh, my heart is racing so fast...！ Kazamine Setsugekka, here I go！！」
She readies her wrist and prepares to initiate the capture.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The distance should be right... I think？ But where exactly is it behind... Ugh, it’s not really clear.」
The Mega Rare seems to be moving, as the readings keep flickering in and out. There's nothing left to do but leave it to fate...！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Now, hyaaaah！！」
The capture schematic appears on the screen... Success or failure, which will it be？

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, what’s that sound！？ Did we get it！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um... did I... succeed？ For real！？」
The capture success screen, which they had seen many times before, appeared on the HR.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It says Pochemon... Nyangoal Mark II. Teacher, look at this...」

name: Iori
message: 「Congratulations！！ A Mega Rare, caught！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We did ittt！！ Mega Rare, caught, baby~♪」
The two of them instinctively shout, grab each other’s hands, and jump up and down repeatedly.

name: Iori
message: 「Thank you, thank you so much！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Phew... that was more nerve-wracking than a match！」

name: Iori
message: 「Man, I’m just glad we managed to catch it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If it had escaped, what would you have done, Teacher？」

name: Iori
message: 「...I might have cried.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You’d cry！？ I’d actually kind of like to see that~」
Well, I’d only do that in private once I got back to my room, though.

name: Iori
message: 「I want to get you a reward for all your hard work, Setsugekka. Is there anything you want？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then, how about a grill...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, please spare me anything that costs money.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muu, then how about... headpats？」

name: Iori
message: 「If you’re fine with that, I don’t mind at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Afu, fuwaaa... This is so soothing... Truly the ultimate reward time~」
I rest my hand on Setsugekka's head and gently pet her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Your hands are really big, Sensei.」
Setsugekka, looking blissfully entranced.

name: Iori
message: 「If anything, I think your head is just small, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh~... Are you saying I'm dumb？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, I mean you have a small face.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehehe, that actually makes me a little happy.」
As I stroke Setsugekka's long, silky hair, I strangely start feeling soothed myself.

name: Iori
message: 「I-Is that enough for now？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way~ I caught a mega-rare, so I need mega-rare-class petting too!」

name: Iori
message: 「Mega-rare-class petting... What am I even supposed to do for that?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Maybe try petting somewhere other than my head？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Wouldn't that get kinda lewd?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-Um... Please pet somewhere that isn't lewd.」
That's a tall order...

name: Iori
message: 「Then how about something like this？」
I place my hand on Setsugekka's cheek and give it a gentle stroke.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fuwaa... That's so soothing, nya~...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Funya~n, myao~n... kuuu~n」
Whoa, Setsugekka's turned into a Nyankuru...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Funyaaa... This is the beeest~...」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, how about turning back into a human soon?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Purr, purr... Just a little longer...」
Setsugekka, rubbing her cheek against my hand on her own. Every now and then, her lips brush against my hand.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehehe, having you pet me really calms me down, Sensei.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Back in the day, Kei-chan used to comfort me by petting me all over like this.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Though lately, you haven’t done it for me at all~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You don’t spoil me, it’s lonely, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you really are a spoiled brat, aren't you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I suppose so~ I act all tough like that normally, but truth be told, I love being spoiled~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It’s just that I feel at ease when I’m by the side of someone I can rely on. That would be Kei-chan, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I feel like I can rely on you, Teacher, just as much as I can on Kei-chan, and for some reason, I’ve grown fond of you~」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I see.」
……Did I just get confessed to?

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, could you pretend you didn’t hear that just now？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, sure thing.」
And just like that, the reward time for Setsugekka came to an end.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, crap… I’ve stayed relaxed for too long！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haa… Teacher, you’re fast~！」
The start of class was drawing near with every passing moment. The two of us hurried toward the classroom.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, it was a bit of a surprise that you’re into games, Teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「I actually quite like them. Raising things and the like.」

name: Iori
message: 「I grow houseplants in my room, and back at my parents' house, we have a gardening space, you know.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh~ So you’re not just into digital critters, but actual living things too, huh.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t call them ‘living things’.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then, by any chance, do you like kids too？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course！」
Kids are cute, full of energy, and healing; I could watch them forever.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You’re right, Teacher. You really do seem like you’d make a good dad~」

name: Iori
message: 「I get told that by a lot of people.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In the future, how many kids do you want to have？」

name: Iori
message: 「The more, the better. Any number is fine！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-is that so... Whoever becomes your wife in the future is going to have to work really hard, then.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hm, that’s true indeed...」
Childbirth puts a massive strain on the mother. One must gain knowledge and be truly considerate.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-it’s okay, really！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can manage up to about nine kids！ Let’s work hard and raise them together！」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, wait, there are procedures like marriage and all sorts of things before that, you know？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, that’s right. If we’re going to have children, the procedure is important. Yes, the procedure for making babies...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...You pervert, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, that’s not it！ That’s not what I meant！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Everyone, listen up—Muragaki-sensei is talking about the procedure for making babies！」

name: Iori
message: 「Waaah！？ Stop it~~~~！！」
I grabbed Setsugekka, who had started shouting at the top of her lungs, and hurriedly covered her mouth.
